localBiteReport: Reports from the week of September 18–24 out of Destin describe one of the best inshore bites of the year on Choctawhatchee Bay, with redfish (both slot fish and bulls), flounder, and speckled trout all responding to a major increase in available baitfish. Capt. Adam Schroeder (Ignite The Bite Charters, Destin) noted that croakers and spot minnows are the go-to live baits for larger redfish around bridges, while flounder and trout are also mixed into the action when bait is present. Mangrove snapper are stacking around Brooks Bridge, Destin Bridge, jetties, and deeper docks, providing a bonus keeper species. Tidal movement is key — the outgoing tide around bridges has been the most productive window for redfish. Water temperature on the bay is currently 85°F.
